system.description:
You draw an arcane symbol on an object that imparts one of the following magical effects:

  • Bind. A reader of LV 6 or less is paralyzed for 1 hour. (@UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.conditions.Item.ROTpAUAHx5s4AZZh]{Condition: Paralyzed})

  • Harm. The reader takes [[/r 3d6]] damage.

  • Message. The reader hears a brief mental message.

  • Teleportation Sigil. Treat the object as a teleportation sigil per the @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.spells.Item.F9tt99DLLvAGukpg]{teleport} spell.

The glyph disappears once activated.
